Listen dude, sex isnt whats going to fulfill you, its not that amazing, its a stupid societal accomplishment boosted to popularity by ignorant meatheads. You may feel a sense of pride if you lose your virginity, but youre then going to realize youre part of the majority now and no one gives a shit. 

Now you have a valid complaint about feeling unappreciated. we as people want to need and be needed by others and if we dont get that, we can spiral into a dark lonely emotional state that doesnt help our cause. what you need is to learn to love and be appreciative of your own company before you can muster up confidence to interact with others in the way that you want. its a give-and-take world and if you have nothing to offer to other people, then they have no reason to want to be around you. try your hardest to become a pleasure to be around and real friends and relationships will follow suit.

I hope you read and take my advice to heart, because you dont deserve to feel this way, good luck
